title: Energy through a solar panel
caption: The panel receives 1.6 m² × 1000 W m⁻² = 1600 W of sunlight. At 22% efficiency it delivers 352 W of electrical power; the other 1248 W (about 1250 W) is reflected or becomes heat, mostly because photons above the band gap waste their excess energy and those below it are not absorbed.
alt: Energy flow diagram: 1600 watts of sunlight in, 352 watts of electrical power out and 1248 watts lost as heat and reflection.
